name: Midjourney
knownFor: A prompt-to-image (and now video) service, still one of the best-known independent image products.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Midjourney remains one of the most widely discussed dedicated image products, but this session did not find a comparable public visit-share table for image tools.
pro: Clear official price ladder and a long-standing dedicated user base
con: Popularity here is editorial; there is no Similarweb-style share table on this page
costCaption: Official midjourney.com/pricing (checked Nov 2026): Basic $10/month ($8/month billed yearly), Standard $30/month ($24 yearly), Pro $60/month ($48 yearly), Mega $120/month ($96 yearly). Rated on Basic, the cheapest individual paid plan.

name: ChatGPT Images
knownFor: Image generation and editing inside ChatGPT, billed as part of a ChatGPT plan rather than a standalone seat.
popCaption: Rides ChatGPT’s leading website-visit share (55.7% in October 2026, Similarweb). This is not a separate product-traffic figure · checked Nov 2026
pro: Distribution through the largest assistant website in the Similarweb set
con: Not a standalone product; quality and limits follow the ChatGPT plan
costCaption: Included with ChatGPT plans. Rated on ChatGPT Plus at $20/month (OpenAI Help, checked Nov 2026). Image tools are also described on chatgpt.com/pricing (Plus and Pro). API image use is billed separately.

name: Gemini Images
knownFor: Image generation and editing in the Gemini app and Google Search (including Nano Banana / Imagen-family models).
popCaption: Rides Gemini’s second-place website-visit share (24.2% in October 2026, Similarweb). This is not a separate image-product traffic figure · checked Nov 2026
pro: Huge built-in distribution in Google products
con: Not a standalone image studio; limits depend on the Google AI plan
costCaption: Included with Google AI plans. Rated on Google AI Pro at $19.99/month (one.google.com, checked Nov 2026). Google AI Plus at $4.99/month also advertises more access to image generation than the free tier.

name: Adobe Firefly
knownFor: Adobe’s generative image (and now video) tools, built into Firefly’s own app and into Photoshop, Express, and other Creative Cloud apps.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Firefly’s distribution inside Creative Cloud is the reason for the score; this session did not find a standalone public visit-share figure.
pro: Sits inside tools many designers already use, with commercial-use framing from Adobe
con: No official individual price was captured this session, so the cost band is an estimate
costCaption: Firefly is sold through Adobe plans (Firefly, Express, and Creative Cloud). This session did not capture a single clean official individual monthly figure from Adobe’s pricing pages. Editorial estimate $$$ for a typical paid Creative Cloud or Firefly individual plan. Confirm current list prices on adobe.com.

name: Flux
knownFor: An image model family from Black Forest Labs, used through the official Flux app and many API hosts.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Flux is widely used as a model behind other apps and APIs; this session did not find a single official consumer-traffic figure.
learn: Developers and power users who want Flux itself
pro: A widely adopted image model family, including open-weight variants
con: Usage-based and multi-host pricing does not map cleanly to one monthly seat
costCaption: Flux is sold as a model and through official and third-party apps; pricing is often usage-based. This session did not capture a single official individual monthly plan. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual spend. Confirm current prices on blackforestlabs.ai or the host you use.

name: Ideogram
knownFor: An image generator known for unusually reliable text rendering in images.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. No comparable public visit-share figure was found this session.
learn: Posters and images that must include words
pro: Strong reputation for rendering letters and logos in images
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Ideogram sells paid plans, but ideogram.ai/pricing was not readable this session (the request was blocked). Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on ideogram.ai.

name: Leonardo
knownFor: A web studio for image generation with presets, training, and a production-oriented workflow.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. No comparable public visit-share figure was found this session.
pro: A dedicated workspace rather than a single chat box
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Leonardo sells paid plans, but leonardo.ai/pricing was not readable this session (the request was blocked). Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on leonardo.ai.

name: Recraft
knownFor: An image and vector tool aimed at brand-consistent design work, including SVG output.
pro: Vector and brand-kit features that many art generators lack
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Recraft sells individual paid plans, but this session did not capture a current official monthly figure from the vendor’s pricing page. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on recraft.ai.

name: Grok Imagine
knownFor: Image (and short video) generation inside Grok, sold through the X Subscription.
popCaption: Tied to Grok’s 2.2% share of seven tracked assistant websites in October 2026 (Similarweb). This is not a separate Imagine-product traffic figure · checked Nov 2026
pro: Bundled with a live-search assistant, so you do not need a second app
con: Website-visit share for Grok is still small; this is not a dedicated image studio
costCaption: Included with the X Subscription. Rated on Premium at $30/month, the plan marked most popular on x.ai/pricing (checked Nov 2026). Plus at $8/month also lists Imagine. A free tier with limited generation is described on x.ai/grok.

name: DreamStudio
knownFor: Stability AI’s official web app for Stable Diffusion family models.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. The open Stable Diffusion family is widely used; DreamStudio itself is only one front end.
pro: Sits next to a very widely used open-model family
con: Credit pricing does not map to one seat, and the front-end app is not the whole ecosystem
costCaption: DreamStudio and the Stability API are usage-based (credits). This session did not capture a current official individual monthly price. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual credit spend. Confirm current prices on stability.ai.

name: Microsoft Designer
knownFor: A design and image app in the Microsoft 365 / Copilot family, aimed at social posts and simple layouts.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Designer rides Microsoft 365 distribution; no standalone public visit-share figure was found.
learn: Simple layouts in a Microsoft 365 subscription
pro: Easy if you already pay for Microsoft 365
con: Not a specialist image model playground
costCaption: Designer is included with Microsoft 365 plans. Rated on Microsoft 365 Premium at $19.99/month (microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/pricing/individuals, checked Nov 2026) when used as part of that bundle. A more limited free or web experience may also exist — confirm on designer.microsoft.com.

name: SeaArt
knownFor: A high-volume consumer image community and generator, with many model presets.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Community traffic is often cited anecdotally; no official share figure was found this session.
pro: A large library of community models and presets
con: Official price and a cited traffic figure were not captured this session
costCaption: SeaArt offers a free tier and paid credit or membership plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $ for a typical low-cost individual plan. Confirm current prices on seaart.ai.
